standard.label: AlloFlow AP U.S. History internal-foundation structural and editorial QA v1
standard.meaning: Automated pass signals cover deterministic structure, period balance, historical-thinking-skill presence, answer-key distribution, feedback completeness, public-source linkage, independent-authoring declarations, native-library inventory and structure, original accessible diagrams, unscored workshop safeguards, and source/deploy parity.
standard.limitation: Automated QA cannot establish AP U.S. History content validity, distractor functioning, fairness, accessibility conformance, rights clearance, psychometric quality, official AP alignment, score meaning, or release readiness. College Board has not reviewed or endorsed these materials.

signals.meaning: Pack and library identities, versions, preview state, and cross-links are structurally consistent.
Six hundred original internal items are distributed across all nine public framework periods and sixty ten-item banks.
All 105 current public framework topic IDs are represented; this is content coverage, not official exam equivalence.
Two original 50-item depth slices bring every current framework topic to at least two internal items.
A third original 60-item slice strengthens lighter historical-thinking skills and reasoning processes across 60 topics.
A 40-item original completion slice brings every current framework topic to at least three internal items.
A 100-item original completion slice brings every current framework topic to at least four internal items.
An 80-item original fifth-layer balance slice strengthens practice depth across 80 topics while every current framework topic retains at least four items.
A 40-item original fifth-layer completion slice brings every current framework topic to at least five internal items.
A 60-item original sixth-layer balance slice adds another practice angle across 60 topics while preserving five-item coverage for every current framework topic.
All six public historical-thinking skills are represented in the foundation sample.
Comparison, causation, and continuity-and-change remain represented with a substantive internal balance sample.
Answer positions follow the declared 150/150/150/150 structural distribution; this is not psychometric evidence.
Every item and chapter check has one prompt, four distinct options, and a valid key.
Every item has a rationale and four option-level feedback records.
Public framework and factual-reference links plus independent-original provenance declarations are complete.
Automated QA confirms only that restricted-content and release flags remain closed; it is not independent rights clearance.
Automated QA confirms text/reading-order declarations and a still-pending independent accessibility gate.
Automated QA confirms the independent AP U.S. History expert gate remains pending and release-blocking.
Automated QA confirms the items remain uncalibrated and ineligible for score inference or release.
No exact normalized prompt duplicate appears in the internal sample.
Item stems remain complete questions rather than dangling template text.
Every item resolves to an internal topic learning target and lesson route.
Declared chapter, section, check, study-aid, and workshop counts match the actual library.
Chapters, references, review declarations, and release boundaries remain structurally complete.
Each native lesson has structured blocks, examples, nonexamples, evidence tables, and retrieval prompts.
Optional original diagram specifications have accessible text equivalents and remain unscored.
SAQ-, DBQ-, and LEQ-style workshops remain original, synthetic, unscored, non-predictive, and release-ineligible.
When deployment mirrors exist, they are byte-identical to source; absent pre-build mirrors are deferred.

blockers.requiredEvidence: Independent intellectual-property and public-use review of both assets.
Independent WCAG/assistive-technology review plus production screen-reader and voice validation.
Independent review by a current AP U.S. History educator or faculty subject expert.
Independent review of historical accuracy, periodization, framing, and item quality.
End-to-end browser, keyboard, hands-free, and deployment validation.
Representative learner field testing and documented item/library revisions.
Qualified psychometric review and calibration before any score or readiness inference.
Fresh verification of the current CED, clarifications, exam mode, timing, policies, and public-use boundary.

independentHumanReview.note: These are genuine release blockers. Their presence is expected and does not make structural QA fail; automated checks must never convert them into completed reviews.

deploymentParity.note: Source and deployment bytes are identical.
Source and deployment bytes are identical.

blueprint.framework: AP U.S. History Course and Exam Description, Effective Fall 2026, Course Framework V.1

thirdLayerCompletion.note: A 40-item original completion slice adds a third practice angle for every topic that was previously at two items, with five additional deepeners; this remains an internal foundation rather than an official exam form.

fourthLayerCompletion.note: A 100-item original completion slice adds a fourth practice angle for every topic that was previously at three items; this remains an internal foundation rather than an official exam form.

fifthLayerBalance.note: An 80-item original fifth-layer balance slice strengthens cross-period practice depth before the fifth-layer completion slice finishes minimum coverage; this remains an internal foundation rather than an official exam form.

fifthLayerCompletion.note: A 40-item original completion slice adds a fifth practice angle for the 25 topics that were previously at four items, with 15 additional deepeners; this remains an internal foundation rather than an official exam form.

sixthLayerBalance.note: A 60-item original sixth-layer balance slice adds another practice angle across 60 topics while preserving full five-item coverage; this remains an internal foundation rather than an official exam form.

releaseAssessment.reason: Automated structural QA passed, but every independent review, production, field-test, psychometric, and re-verification gate remains open.
